# anthropic_agents (Data Source)

Lists Managed Agents agents in the workspace.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_agents" "all" {
  include_archived = false
}

output "agent_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_agents.all.agents[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived agents. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Attributes List) Agents. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agents))

<a id="nestedatt--agents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agents`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Agent id.
- `model` (String) Model id.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Current version.
